title: Vietnamese Legal Document Relationship Schema
description: Canonical schema for relationships between Vietnamese legal documents and the specific legal provisions they amend, add, replace, or repeal.

source_document.description: Stable ID of the document that creates the legal change, e.g. D238-2026-ND-CP.

target_document.description: Stable ID of the document being amended, supplemented, replaced, or repealed, e.g. D168-2024-ND-CP.

relationships.description: List of legal relationships from a provision in the source document to a target provision.

source_ref.description: Stable ID of the source provision in the source document.

target_ref.description: Stable ID of the target provision in the target document. Must refer to an existing node; never guess.

description.description: Optional concise explanation of what the source provision does to the target provision.
